Title: Navbar Component
Summary: Global top navigation bar with responsive mobile menu and active route highlighting.
Content:
## NavbarComponent

**Selector:** `app-navbar`

**Imports:** `RouterLink`, `RouterLinkActive`

### State (Signals)
- `navItems: Signal<NavItem[]>` — Navigation links array
- `isMenuOpen: WritableSignal<boolean>` — Mobile menu toggle state

### Methods
- `toggleMenu(): void` — Toggles the mobile hamburger menu

### Nav Items
| Label | Route |
|-------|-------|
| Home | `/` |
| Docs | `/docs` |
| Getting Started | `/docs/getting-started` |
| API Reference | `/docs/api` |
| FAQ | `/docs/faq` |

### Behavior
- Uses Bootstrap `navbar-expand-lg` for responsive collapse
- Active route highlighted with `routerLinkActive="active"`
- Mobile menu closes on nav item click
- External GitHub link in outline button style
